args.title: Failed scheduled run 42284432095 — nai-occ-oi-daily exits 1 in occ_oi_daily.py
args.body:
Reporting only (Venice lane: GPT owns the fix).

- Run: 42284432095 — https://github.com/SRoyaltyy/checklist-engine/actions/runs/42284432095
- Job: 128121492870 — https://github.com/SRoyaltyy/checklist-engine/actions/runs/42284432095/job/128121492870
- Workflow: nai-occ-oi-daily; branch main; sha e85547ac99a28737321c063cf15cd96729c229ce; conclusion failure
- Failing step: Run python scripts/nai/occ_oi_daily.py — annotation: Process completed with exit code 1. (.github line 12)
- Skipped step: Run python scripts/nai/oi_probe.py (never ran, so no probe output)

Job log text is not retrievable through the bridge toolset; failure site inferred from source instead. In scripts/nai/occ_oi_daily.py (sha 3633301eee1228ae12d1c47e95b72f549a03807c, 35 lines) the first network call is unguarded:

- line 8: delo = get("https://marketdata.theocc.com/delo-download?prodType=ALL&downloadFields=OS;US;SN&format=txt", ua=BROWSER).decode("latin1") — no try/except
- ensure_release, assets and upload are likewise unguarded

The per-ticker loop is wrapped in try/except and increments fails, so the crash is before the loop (DELO download or release setup), not a per-symbol fetch error. Any HTTP status/HTML/error response from the OCC DELO endpoint, or a release/token error, produces a traceback and exit 1.

Run annotations also carry only boilerplate: Node 20 deprecation warning on actions/checkout@v4 and the ubuntu-latest->26 migration notice — neither is causal.

Next scheduled occurrence will hit the same path unless the DELO call is guarded or its response validated.
